title: Motivating and rewarding!
body:
I’m quickly approaching my Leaving Cert and downloaded this app because I realised I often pick up my phone too much while trying to study. I was skeptical at first, but it’s great! 

I enjoy seeing the visuals of all the plants in my forest as a result of my study sessions, and earning coins through the time spent motivates me to keep studying so I can earn enough coins for a new plant to add. It’s rewarding because I’m both preparing for my exams and I get to buy more plants!

There’s nice motivational messages that pop up when you pick up your phone/open the app, and you can even add some yourself.

I no longer pick up my phone, to avoid withering the plants, and it’s a good habit to have picked up. Although, there is the option to allow certain apps if you know you may need to use them. 

Overall, I’m satisfied with what the app offers for the price!  I hope to continue using it for other activities once my Leaving Cert is over :)

body:
I never buy apps but the once-off payment for this app is entirely worth it and I urge you to go through with it if you’re considering.
Beautiful design, gentle green colours and options for what tree you want to plant.
Staring at a computer all day, it’s nice for your timer to be images of green and soft browns and trees.
The encouraging messages are also good without being patronising.
It’s also reinforcing to see the number of trees you planted that day. 
I like how you can change the timer on the trees too and change tree types when you feel like a change.
Overall it has vastly improved my ability to focus on the task at hand and I look forward to using it everyday. Brilliant app.
